verdict.rationale: Visa documents fraud-prevention mechanics (agent signatures, mandates, step-up authentication, network-level controls) and notes that 'commerce signals' plus user instructions can help 'resolve any disputes,' but it stops short of stating explicit liability/chargeback allocation rules — the same source explicitly notes the docs 'stop at evidence capture, not a dispute API.' Missing for 10: an explicit liability-shift statement (who eats fraud losses — issuer, merchant, or Visa), documented chargeback rights/timelines for agent-initiated transactions, and any dispute-resolution API or process beyond evidence collection.
